newsitem.title: USA: Lawter and Hach in stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Lawter and Hach in stock buyback.

text.p: Specialty chemical company Lawter International Inc said Thursday it agreed to sell to Hach Co about 27.8 percent of the stock it holds in Hach for $19 a share.
The 3,157,220 shares, to be purchased for a total price of $59,987,180, represents all of Lawter's holdings in Hach.
The net cash received after tax by Lawter from this transaction is expected to be about $39 million.
The purchase is expected to be completed by July 8, 1997.

"Our board felt that in order to enhance shareholder value, this was the appropriate time to liquidate our investment in Hasch, the proceeds of which will be used to further Lawter's long-term plans," said John O'Mahoney, Lawter chairman and chief executive officer, in a news release.
